candidates.name: Kelley Bros of New England, LLC
candidates.partition_evidence: Its Division 10 page lists toilet partitions in every material and mounting style, names Global, Scranton and Hadrian, and offers a turnkey service from quote to installation. Its locations page lists a Barre, VT installation branch at (802) 923-2004.
candidates.reason: A commercial Division 8/10 supplier with a Williston office inside the area and a Vermont installation branch, and it says it installs partitions. It also supplies partitions itself (Global, Scranton, Hadrian), so there is a high buy-around risk.
red_flags: Large multi-state distributor, not an install-only sub

license.name: Kelley Bros of New England, LLC
license.registry: None applies: Vermont Office of Professional Regulation residential contractor registration covers residential jobs only; Burlington has no city contractor license rule on file
license.note: Vermont has no state contractor license for commercial partition installation. State registration (26 V.S.A. ch. 106, s. 5501) applies only to residential contractors on jobs of $10,000 or more in buildings of four or fewer units. Only electrical and plumbing are state-licensed. The project's local rule for Burlington is 'none'. No lookup was run, and no license number is recorded. The OPR residential contractor page returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch on 2026-11-20. Its registration lookup was not used because commercial partition work falls outside it. Base city: Williston. Checked 2026-11-20.
